$comment: Grammar counterpart of man-006 (#176 item 17): man-006 covers a missing REQUIRED member, this one a value outside its grammar. Otherwise identical to man-005 without `extensions`, so the `http://` scheme is the only defect under test.
description: A Manifest whose `handshake_endpoint` uses the `http` scheme. `aitp-manifest.schema.json` requires the value to match `^https://` (RFC-AITP-0003 §3), so RFC-AITP-0003 §5 step 2 rejects the Manifest before any proof-of-possession or signature work. Receivers MUST reject with MANIFEST_INVALID.

expected.rationale: A value outside its grammar is a structural defect (RFC-AITP-0003 §5 step 2; registry structural-rejection table). The Manifest is otherwise well-formed and unexpired.
